title: Linear Adversarial Concept Erasure
objective: max over rank-(d-K) orthogonal projections P of min over GLM theta of attribute loss on P s
transformation: Linear orthogonal projection (rank K); RLACE Fantope relaxation for classification
guarantees: Closed-form optimum for linear regression (K=1: remove direction S^T a) and PLS; none for relaxation; linear adversaries only
datasets: GloVe gender; Bias in Bios (BERT frozen/fine-tuned); CelebA pixels
evaluation: Linear probe accuracy, WEAT, TPR-GAP, downstream accuracy
limitations: Linear only; joint adversaries do not generalise to new test-time adversaries (fn. 11)
relevance_to_three_objective_question: For scalar age with squared loss equals orthogonal projection removing Cov(S,A): same erasure level as LEACE, different distortion; matters for categorical attributes

title: LEACE: Perfect linear concept erasure in closed form
authors: Belrose, Schneider-Joseph, Ravfogel, Cotterell, Raff, Biderman
objective: min E||PS-S||^2_M s.t. Cov(PS,A)=0
transformation: Affine oblique projection P*=I-W+ P_{W Sigma_SA} W (+ bias); oracle version = OLS residual on A
guarantees: Linear guardedness <=> Sigma_SA=0 (categorical; continuous under OLS); minimal distortion for every psd M
datasets: Bias in Bios; POS concept scrubbing in Pythia/LLaMA
evaluation: Linear probe accuracy; downstream fairness; LM perplexity
limitations: Linear only; in-sample guarantee (fails out of sample when n~d, this project E50); kernel erasers do not transfer
relevance_to_three_objective_question: Eraser behind E45-E55; oracle version admissible because age is observed at inference and gives perfect substitution

title: Fundamental Limits of Perfect Concept Erasure
authors: Basu Roy Chowdhury, Dubey, Beirami, Kidambi, Monath, Ahmed, Chaturvedi
objective: max I(Z;S) s.t. I(Z;A)<=eps (privacy/erasure funnel)
transformation: Piecewise bijection per concept group to a common law (PEF); MEC coupling for unequal laws
guarantees: Perfect erasure feasible if smallest PIC=0 or |S|>|A|; I(Z;S)<=H(S|A) with equality iff H(S|Z,A)=0; funnel bounds
datasets: Synthetic; GloVe gender; Jigsaw religion/toxicity with GPT-4 embeddings
evaluation: KDE MI estimates; probe accuracy; fairness-utility
limitations: Finite-support assumption with disjoint group supports; hard in low-resource settings
relevance_to_three_objective_question: Equality condition H(S|Z,A)=0 is task-agnostic perfect metadata substitution

title: Obliviator Reveals the Cost of Nonlinear Guardedness in Concept Erasure
objective: inf HSIC(Z,A) - HSIC(Z,Y) (supervised) or preserve S (unsupervised), solved iteratively
transformation: Nonlinear encoder trained with HSIC losses + RKHS eigen-problem refinement, iterated
guarantees: Characteristic-kernel HSIC=0 iff independence; no optimisation or finite-sample guarantee (stated open)
datasets: Dial-Mention, Dial-Sentiment, Bias in Bios with BERT, GPT-2, LLaMA, DeepSeek
evaluation: Utility-erasure curves vs MLP adversary accuracy
limitations: Needs attribute (and task) labels; non-convex; output dimensionality not guaranteed
relevance_to_three_objective_question: Task-preserving nonlinear erasure already established; capability eases erasure (cf. E6)

title: Nonlinear Concept Erasure: a Density Matching Approach (LEOPARD)
venue: ECAI 2025 per repository (FAIA vol. 413); arXiv 2507.12341 (one listing names AIQxQIA workshop)
objective: min MMD^2 between class-conditional laws of projected embeddings + orthogonality penalty
guarantees: MMD=0 iff equal laws (characteristic kernels); no optimisation guarantee
datasets: GloVe ternary gender; Bias in Bios; DIAL race
evaluation: Probe accuracy (linear/nonlinear), downstream accuracy, WS-353, fairness
limitations: Discrete concepts only; kernel bandwidth and batch-size sensitivity
relevance_to_three_objective_question: Projection-constrained nonlinear baseline; continuous age needs bins or continuous dependence

title: Principled Nonlinear Concept Erasure and Steering
objective: Reconstruction of S from (Z,A) + independence Z indep A; no task labels
transformation: Conditional autoencoder: encoder e(S) (A-free at inference), decoder d(Z,A); steering by changing A
guarantees: Discrete idealised: perfect reconstruction + independence => I(Z;S)=H(S|A), maximal (Thm 1); approximate preservation under Lipschitz left-inverse (Prop 1)
datasets: Several text datasets and language models
evaluation: Probe-based erasure, held-out dependence tests, utility, steering
limitations: Idealised guarantees; finite-sample/non-convex training not guaranteed; text only
relevance_to_three_objective_question: Closest formalisation of 'erase but recoverable given A': implies perfect metadata substitution for any task; does not measure downstream value of A
